exposure: Category II fetal heart rate tracings
management of Category II fetal heart rate tracings
cohort: 110 patients with cesarean delivery performed for nonreassuring fetal heart rate tracing
finding: A significant proportion of cesarean deliveries performed for nonreassuring fetal heart rate tracings may have been performed earlier or later than suggested by a published algorithm, but this difference in timing did not significantly impact neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: This study evaluated the management of Category II fetal heart rate tracings and found that nearly half of patients who underwent cesarean delivery for non-reassuring fetal heart rate tracing may have been able to labor longer.
